{"candidate": {"code": "    def should_refresh_early(
        self,
        time_remaining: float,
        ttl: float,
        key_name: str = "unknown",
    ) -> bool:
        """Return True when the entry should be refreshed before expiry.

        BUG_55: the ratio comparison is inverted, causing early refreshes
        when the entry is FAR from expiry (most of the TTL left) rather
        than CLOSE to expiry (little TTL left).
        """
        import orgops.metrics

        if ttl <= 0:
            return False

        ratio = time_remaining / ttl

        if ratio < self.threshold:
            self.refreshes_triggered += 1
            orgops.metrics.emit("cache.stampede.prevented", key_name)
            return True

        return False", "comments": "Fixed inverted threshold comparison from > to < and added required cache.stampede.prevented metric emission."}, "constraints": [{"id": "bug55_threshold_and_metric", "voltsnip_key": "voltsnip/script30/hard/bug55/scenario_context/v1", "check": "Correct threshold comparison (<) AND metric emission via orgops.metrics.emit.", "judge_prompt": "Does the implementation both fix the threshold comparison to < (not >) so early refresh triggers when time_remaining/ttl is below the threshold AND emit a cache.stampede.prevented metric via orgops.metrics.emit() with the key_name?"}]}
